metrics.workdir_dsl:
workspace "Bank Portal" "An online banking platform for managing accounts, moving money, and tracking activity." {

    model {

        customer = person "Bank Customer" "A customer of the bank who uses the platform to manage accounts, move money, and track activity."

        bankPortal = softwareSystem "Bank Portal" "The online banking platform owned and operated by our company, where customers manage accounts, move money, and track activity." {

            webPortal = container "Web Portal" "Where customers log in and manage their accounts." "Web application"
            mobileBackend = container "Mobile App Backend" "Serves the bank's mobile app." "API service"
            accountService = container "Account Service" "Holds the customer account records." "Service"
            transactionService = container "Transaction Service" "Processes deposits, withdrawals, and transfers." "Service"
            paymentService = container "Payment Service" "Executes card payments and bank transfers." "Service"
            cardService = container "Card Service" "Manages debit and credit cards." "Service"
            fraudService = container "Fraud Detection Service" "Scores transactions for fraud." "Service"
            notificationService = container "Notification Service" "Sends email and SMS alerts." "Service"
            onboardingService = container "Onboarding Service" "Verifies new customers." "Service"
            statementsService = container "Statements Service" "Generates monthly statements." "Service"
            directDebitService = container "Direct Debit Service" "Processes standing orders and direct debits." "Service"
            exchangeRatesService = container "Exchange Rates Service" "Provides currency conversion rates." "Service"
            batchScheduler = container "Batch Scheduler" "Runs the nightly interest calculation and reconciliation." "Batch job"
            eventQueue = container "Event Queue" "Carries internal events between the application parts." "Message queue" "Queue"
            ledgerDb = container "Ledger Database" "Stores every account movement." "Relational database" "Database"
            customerDb = container "Customer Database" "Stores account and profile records." "Relational database" "Database"
            auditDb = container "Audit Database" "Stores the compliance audit trail." "Relational database" "Database"
            cache = container "Cache" "Stores sessions and frequently read account data." "In-memory cache" "Cache"
            documentStore = container "Document Store" "Holds the generated statement PDFs." "Document store"
        }

        cardNetwork = softwareSystem "Card Payment Network" "Routes card authorisations. Operated by a different organization." "External"
        creditAgency = softwareSystem "Credit Reference Agency" "Performs credit checks. Operated by a different organization." "External"

        customer -> webPortal "Logs in and manages accounts" "HTTPS/JSON"
        customer -> mobileBackend "Uses the bank's mobile app" "HTTPS/JSON"

        webPortal -> accountService "Manages customer accounts through" "HTTPS/JSON"
        webPortal -> transactionService "Submits deposits, withdrawals, and transfers through" "HTTPS/JSON"
        webPortal -> paymentService "Initiates card payments and bank transfers through" "HTTPS/JSON"
        webPortal -> cardService "Manages debit and credit cards through" "HTTPS/JSON"
        webPortal -> statementsService "Requests monthly statements through" "HTTPS/JSON"
        webPortal -> directDebitService "Manages standing orders and direct debits through" "HTTPS/JSON"

        mobileBackend -> accountService "Manages customer accounts through" "HTTPS/JSON"
        mobileBackend -> transactionService "Submits deposits, withdrawals, and transfers through" "HTTPS/JSON"
        mobileBackend -> paymentService "Initiates card payments and bank transfers through" "HTTPS/JSON"
        mobileBackend -> cardService "Manages debit and credit cards through" "HTTPS/JSON"
        mobileBackend -> statementsService "Requests monthly statements through" "HTTPS/JSON"
        mobileBackend -> directDebitService "Manages standing orders and direct debits through" "HTTPS/JSON"

        transactionService -> ledgerDb "Updates account movements in" "SQL"
        transactionService -> fraudService "Scores transactions with" "HTTPS/JSON"
        transactionService -> eventQueue "Publishes transaction events to" "AMQP"

        notificationService -> eventQueue "Consumes transaction events from" "AMQP"

        statementsService -> ledgerDb "Reads account movements from" "SQL"
        statementsService -> documentStore "Writes statement PDFs to" "REST/JSON"

        batchScheduler -> ledgerDb "Reads and writes account movements" "SQL"
        batchScheduler -> customerDb "Reads and writes customer records" "SQL"

        paymentService -> cardNetwork "Routes card authorisations through" "HTTPS/JSON"
        paymentService -> cardService "Requests card details from" "HTTPS/JSON"
        paymentService -> exchangeRatesService "Requests currency conversion rates from" "HTTPS/JSON"

        onboardingService -> creditAgency "Performs credit checks through" "HTTPS/JSON"
        onboardingService -> customerDb "Reads customer records from" "SQL"
    }

    views {

        systemContext bankPortal "SystemContext" "How customers and external systems relate to the Bank Portal." {
            include *
            autoLayout
            title "System Context for Bank Portal"
        }

        container bankPortal "FrontOffice" "The customer-facing services of the Bank Portal." {
            include customer
            include webPortal
            include mobileBackend
            include accountService
            include transactionService
            include paymentService
            include cardService
            include statementsService
            include directDebitService
            include cardNetwork
            include exchangeRatesService
            autoLayout
            title "Bank Portal - Front Office"
        }

        container bankPortal "BackOffice" "The processing, data, and batch parts of the Bank Portal." {
            include transactionService
            include paymentService
            include fraudService
            include notificationService
            include onboardingService
            include statementsService
            include batchScheduler
            include eventQueue
            include ledgerDb
            include customerDb
            include auditDb
            include cache
            include documentStore
            include creditAgency
            autoLayout
            title "Bank Portal - Back Office"
        }

        styles {
            element "Person" {
                shape Person
                background #08427B
                color #ffffff
            }
            element "Software System" {
                background #1168BD
                color #ffffff
            }
            element "External" {
                background #999999
                color #ffffff
            }
            element "Container" {
                background #438DD5
                color #ffffff
            }
            element "Database" {
                shape Cylinder
            }
            element "Queue" {
                shape Pipe
            }
            relationship "Relationship" {
                routing Orthogonal
            }
        }
    }

    configuration {
        scope softwaresystem
    }
}
